5.10.validation: 2026.11.6.25 makes the sensor hook load on vendor 6.1 kernels (MEIZU 21, 6.1.25-android14-11). The 6.1 package no longer imports iov_iter_advance, which that kernel does not export, and no longer imports anon_inode_getfile, whose vendor-built struct file_operations makes the modversions CRC disagree and aborts the whole load with "disagrees about version of symbol". The unused iov_iter_advance() call is removed from the send path (the msghdr iterator is still restored), and the four anon_inode_getfile() call sites (touch forward, native notice, register relay, PTE transport) now go through ctf_anon_inode_getfile(), which resolves the address through the driver resolver and calls it from a __nocfi trampoline, returning ERR_PTR(-ENOENT) when absent. Verified on MEIZU 21: insmod succeeds, no unknown-symbol or CRC errors, "liming: sensor ready active=16 buffers=16x32768 rules=8". The other five branches are unchanged code rebuilt from the same source tree and import-audited.
